name: The Prophetess (Isaiah's wife)
title: The Prophet's Wife
summary: The prophetess was the wife of the prophet Isaiah and the mother of at least two sons with symbolic names. She is mentioned by name only once in the Bible, but her role as the mother of children with prophetic names was significant for Isaiah's message to Judah.

keyEvents.title: Referred to as the Prophetess
keyEvents.description: Isaiah refers to his wife as 'the prophetess' when she became pregnant with their second son, which may indicate that she herself had a prophetic gift or function.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz
keyEvents.description: She gave birth to the son Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz, whose name means 'Hasten to the spoil, speed to the plunder' - a prophetic sign of Assyria's coming conquest of Syria and Northern Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Shear-Jashub
keyEvents.description: She was also the mother of Shear-Jashub, whose name means "A remnant shall return" — a sign of both judgment and hope for God's people Israel.
